description: Seven triangle low-frequency oscillators sharing one main rate, each with its own multiplier, in 4HP

params.text: Multiplies or divides that oscillator's rate against the main rate, from a twenty-first of it to twenty-one times it, with the centre position matching
Switches all seven outputs from 0-10V to ±5V

inputs.text: Moves the main rate, ten hertz per volt at full attenuverter, added to the RATE knob

outputs.text: That oscillator's output; the last one can carry all seven as a polyphonic cable instead

notes: this version has no sync, no reset and no phase or shape controls; every oscillator is a triangle running from the RATE knob and its own multiplier.
menu: Polyphony on 7th out: Monophonic, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 — sets how many oscillators the bottom output gathers into one polyphonic cable
Integer * — sets the seven xRate knobs to successive whole-number multiples of the main rate
Integer / — sets the seven xRate knobs to successive whole-number divisions of the main rate
Even * — sets the seven xRate knobs to even-numbered multiples of the main rate
Even / — sets the seven xRate knobs to even-numbered divisions of the main rate
Odd * — sets the seven xRate knobs to odd-numbered multiples of the main rate
Odd / — sets the seven xRate knobs to odd-numbered divisions of the main rate
Prime * — sets the seven xRate knobs to prime-numbered multiples of the main rate
Prime / — sets the seven xRate knobs to prime-numbered divisions of the main rate
Fibonacci * — sets the seven xRate knobs to Fibonacci multiples of the main rate
Fibonacci / — sets the seven xRate knobs to Fibonacci divisions of the main rate

inputs.0:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
